issues.title: Symphony execution agent — OpenAI Symphony-spec runner with credit gate
issues.description:
## Objective

Implement the missing execution agent that picks up Todo issues from Linear, sends them to Ollama (via credit gate), applies code changes, validates, and marks Done.

## Architecture

Follows the OpenAI Symphony spec ([https://github.com/openai/symphony](<https://github.com/openai/symphony>)):

* Poll Linear for Todo issues
* Create isolated workspace
* Run tool-calling AI agent against Ollama
* Validate (typecheck, lint, tests)
* Accept (commit + mark Done) or reject (revert + move to Backlog)

## Implementation

### New files

* `scripts/ops/symphony-runner.mjs` — orchestrator
* `scripts/ops/symphony-agent.mjs` — tool-calling agent loop
* `scripts/ops/symphony-credit-gate.mjs` — provider cascade (Ollama-first, cloud-extensible)
* `tools/harness/symphony/WORKFLOW.md` — agent system prompt
* `services/systemd/anqr-symphony-runner.service` — oneshot service
* `services/systemd/anqr-symphony-runner.timer` — fires after completion

### Credit gate

Ports concepts from master branch [codex-credit-gate.sh](<http://codex-credit-gate.sh>) into JS:

* Probe providers in priority order
* Skip rate-limited/recently-failed providers
* Ollama local is default; cloud providers extensible
* Failure memory state in /run/user/

### Agent tools

* read_file, write_file, patch_file, run_command (allowlisted), list_directory, task_complete
* MAX_TURNS=25, MAX_EXECUTION_MS=300000 (5min)

### Validation

* git diff (files changed?)
* tsc --noEmit (typecheck)
* vitest run (tests)
* lint regression check

### Retry policy

* 1st failure: revert + leave in Todo
* 2nd failure: revert + move to Backlog + needs-decomposition

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Runner picks up a Todo issue and executes it via Ollama
- [ ] Credit gate probes and selects provider
- [ ] Agent makes tool-calling code changes
- [ ] Validation pipeline runs after agent completes
- [ ] Success: commits + marks Done with evidence
- [ ] Failure: reverts + comments with detail
- [ ] systemd timer triggers runner continuously
- [ ] Docs updated
